title: Timeline Export Manifest
description: SPEC-303 §7 export manifest (ticket #51, REQ-OBS-303-005). Repository implementation authority for the manifest document produced by application.observation.timeline.export.build_export. The manifest carries the export ID and creation time (generation metadata — the only fields allowed to differ between reproducible exports of the same immutable journal interval), the requesting scope and filters, the clock domain and bounds, per-kind record counts, the schema version, the redaction policy + version, and the SHA-256 of every CONTENT file (timeline.jsonl / timeline.csv / redaction-report.json). The manifest does not hash itself; the ZIP container's digest rides on the export result's file digests. Additive evolution: new optional properties only; a major version bump is a new $id document (SPEC-301 §8 compatibility posture).

schema_version.description: Manifest document family version; 1.x evolves additively with a new $id, major bumps are breaking.

created_at.description: Export creation reading (generation metadata); semantics is observed for wall-clock creation readings.

clock_domain.description: The single clock domain of the exported interval; null marks a cross-domain export (lanes), which never claims one merged time order (SPEC-303 §4).

record_counts_by_kind.description: Record count per SPEC-303 §3 kind present in this export.

redaction_policy.description: Redaction applied before serialization; strip_payloads replaces payload bodies with a redaction marker while keeping event_id/journal_seq (REQ-OBS-303-001).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact file bytes (lowercase hex).

timepoint.description: Record-level timepoint (SPEC-300 §6; ticket #12 ruling): explicit value_ns + clock_domain + clock_epoch + semantics.
